# Vendored website dependencies

These pinned files are served with the site so navigation, layout and icons do not depend on a third-party CDN at runtime.

- Bootstrap 5.3.3: `bootstrap.min.css`, `bootstrap.bundle.min.js`. Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/ . License: `LICENSE-bootstrap`.
- Bootstrap Icons 1.11.3: `bootstrap-icons.min.css`, `fonts/bootstrap-icons.woff2`, `fonts/bootstrap-icons.woff`. Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/font/ . License: `LICENSE-bootstrap-icons`.

The CSS and JavaScript retain their upstream copyright headers. Google Fonts is optional; the theme includes system-font fallbacks.
